entries.text: 反思: 用户问「明天北京天气怎么样」，小焦答「北京晴」，反馈「bad」。用户更正为「先问城市再查」。下次遇到此类问题应: 直接按更正的方式回答

用户: 女孩在樱花树下散步 -> 精炼: lowly and smoothly, tracking the girl's movement from a low angle, with shallow depth of field blurring the background into a soft bokeh of pink petals and green foliage. The style is reminiscent of a poetic art-house film, with a focus on mood, texture, and the gentle interplay of light and shadow.
用户: 女孩在樱花树下漫步 -> 精炼: A girl walks slowly under a canopy of blooming cherry blossoms, soft morning light filtering through petals, shallow depth of field, cinematic, dreamy, warm tones.

用户: 女孩漫步 -> 精炼: Close-up, soft golden hour sunlight, shallow depth of field, cinematic color grading, a young girl walking through a sunlit meadow, slow motion, dreamy and nostalgic atmosphere, shot on 35mm film.
